liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jack Straw, Sugaree, and Little Red Rooster combo was outstanding in the first set [28]
- **It Must Have Been the Roses** (1 review): It Must Have Been the Roses was described as beautiful by the listener [28]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Listening to Jerry rip it up on Sugaree makes the listener dizzy [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-25.140842.unknown.bryant.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 156 min [1]
- **gd1985-03-25.150966.sbd.latvala.eaton.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1985-03-25.sbd.fix-shinid-15403.tetzeli.84410.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 3.62/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Major squealing noise occurs during Slipknot, alongside periodic static in the recording; Incessant beeping from Jerry's distortion pedal lasts about three minutes during Slipknot [27][34]
- **gd1985-03-25.164911.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 167 min [6]
- **gd1985-03-25.senn421.mccue.ford.34684.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 156 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [20]

## Around the show

- Bobby gives Jerry a run for his money, highlighting the 1985 dynamic [29]
- Listener was 19, a Berklee freshman, and saw lots of smiles between the boys [36]
- Jerry and Weir seemed healthier than in February, though Jerry's voice later faltered [37]
- Springfield shows marked the start of the listener's first tour with the band [38]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-03-25.140842.unknown.bryant.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Robert Bryant; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: Robert Bryant's Master Audience Cassettes; unknown mics > Sony TC-D5M; Transfer Info: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF… [1]
- **gd1985-03-25.150966.sbd.latvala.eaton.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: transferred by Rob Eaton;Tim Dalton;Scott Clugston; source: Master Vault Cassettes > Dick Latvala's 1st generation cassettes > Rob Eaton's DAT (16/48) > Tim Dalton's DAT (16/48) [4]
- **gd1985-03-25.sbd.fix-shinid-15403.tetzeli.84410.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Pitched and patched by Bill Tetzeli; source: Original SRC: MSC>Cass.>DAT>CDR>SHN [5]. Also: Oade Brothers recorded the source using Schoeps CMC441s and Sony PCM-F1; Set one was time and pitch stretched by 104.635 percent [5]
- **gd1985-03-25.164911.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Stephen Thomas; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Stephen Thomas' Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 shotguns > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Stephen Thomas provided the master cassettes for this specific recording [6]
- **gd1985-03-25.senn421.mccue.ford.34684.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mark McCue, Adam, Monica, Johnny Kelly and Davey the beeker meade; transferred by Alex Ford; source: MAC: FOB 2 Sennheiser 421s > Sony TC-D5 > 2 TDK MA90s [20]. Also: High school tapers recorded this FOB, with hardly any edits applied to the source [33]
